summary.name: Day of AI
summary.one_liner: Day of AI is an MIT-led, free K-12 AI literacy curriculum and training program for teachers and students.
use_cases: Teaching AI literacy in K-12 classrooms
Training teachers to instruct about AI
Starting a regional AI education hub
Integrating AI topics into language arts or other subjects
summary.what_it_does: The page describes free, ready-to-teach AI literacy activities that the page says require no AI tools. It says the program has been used by over 10 million students in 170 countries. Teachers can start a hub in their region. The page includes testimonials from teachers saying the materials are well-structured and focus on AI in general rather than promoting a particular product. The page offers a time-based option ("How much time do you have?") for choosing activities, though details are not given in the text.
notable: No AI tools required for activities
Used by over 10 million students in 170 countries
Option to start a regional hub
caveats: Page text does not name specific grade levels, subjects, or lesson formats beyond the K-12 listing
